nodes.question: How much performance improvement, measured in mIoU, is achieved by merging different-architecture models with a shared backbone?
nodes.answer: Merging different-architecture models with a shared backbone achieves a performance improvement of 6.8% in mIoU.

nodes.question: What performance improvements were observed in the research when merging models from different architectures with shared parameters?
nodes.answer: The research demonstrated a 6.8% increase in mean IoU (mIoU) when merging different-architecture models with a shared backbone.
